resources.string: In under a minute you will see where everything is: logging food, your daily targets, Coach, training and progress. You can skip it and replay it any time from Settings.
Calories left for today against your goal, and what your watch or phone says you burned. Swipe left or right here to see other days.
How far along you are with each target. Tap View more for vitamins, minerals and the rest of the day\'s nutrition.
The + button logs food with a photo, by describing it, scanning a barcode, entering it by hand or repeating recent and favorite meals. It also logs water, weight and workouts.
Say what you ate or ask something and the voice assistant logs it for you, hands free.
Your AI coach knows your data. Ask how you are doing, explain your goal so it plans around it, or tell it what you ate and it prepares the log for you to confirm.
Pick a muscle and get three gym machines with sets, reps and rest for your goal. Log your sets to see your progress and get smart suggestions.
Your weight trend, body measurements, steps and the forecast of where you will be in 30, 60 and 90 days.
Change your goal, connect your watch through Health Connect, set your AI key and replay this tour.
Start by logging your next meal. The more you log, the better Coach\'s advice gets.
